description: This PHP class 'Language' in the Opencart admin namespace manages the generation and clearing of language files for the admin interface, specifically creating JSON language files and cleaning them up.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A controller class for generating and clearing language JSON files in the OpenCart admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates language list JSON files for each installed language, creating directories if needed, and handles errors during file creation.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes existing language JSON files for each installed language, effectively clearing cached language data.
